title: Adventure Thrill Park — All Day Dining Plan
content: Adults $39.50; Children (3–9) $24.50. Adults receive 1 main course, 1 side item or dessert, and 1 regular soft drink. Children select from the Kids Meal Menu. Three total items may be redeemed every hour at participating restaurants or kiosks. All Day Diners receive 40% off at Buffalo Grill Restaurant. A souvenir bottle with free refills can be added for $5.
